merged_from: test_a_failed_agent_run_is_unsigned_indeterminate only checks INDETERMINATE plus unsigned. The interim adapter-pending verdict has exactly those properties too, so the test cannot tell 'the failed run took the degraded path' from 'the failure was swallowed and the verdict op reported the agent as having run with zero findings'.

The read-only tool-surface helper `_offered_tools` does not clear REBAR_MCP_READONLY, although the runner's comment gate also reads it through `_runner_support._readonly_gate()`. If that env var is set in the environment, test_default_request_keeps_comment_and_mcp_tools fails spuriously. It also makes the comment_ticket half of test_read_only_request_gets_only_read_tools pass whether or not `req.read_only` works.
scenarios: A DET-passing review with engine="agentic" where the frontier class resolves to a different model than the verifier class. With agent_cfg reverted to gate_cfg, the verdict names the wrong model and no test fails.
